ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point B is the midpoint of segment AD, C is on segment BD and satisfies BD = 3CD. If the sum of the lengths of all segments in the figure is 30, what is the length of segment BC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $CD=x$, then $BC=2x$, $AB=BD=3x$,\\
the sum of all line segments is $AB+AC+AD+BC+BD+CD$\\
$=AB+(AB+BC)+(AB+BD)+BC+BD+CD$\\
$=3x+5x+6x+2x+3x+x$\\
$=20x$,\\
According to the problem, $20x=30$,\\
solving this gives $x=1.5$,\\
thus, $BC=2 \times 1.5=\boxed{3}$,\\
meaning the length of segment BC is 3.
